data.notes: April 2026 in Bangkok was dominated by Songkran-scale electronic and water festivals, with major K-pop arena concerts and T-pop city stages around the holiday window.

events.title: ALL NIGHT LONG with Marmosets
events.summary: Bangkok electronic mainstay Marmosets played an open-to-close Friday night set at Horn, presented as an extended all-night concept.

events.title: NCT WISH 1st Concert Tour ‘INTO THE WISH : Our WISH’ in Bangkok
events.summary: NCT WISH brought their first full-scale Thailand concert to BITEC LIVE, with the official event listing confirming the April 4 Bangkok date.

events.title: ATEEZ 2026 World Tour [IN YOUR FANTASY] in Bangkok
events.summary: ATEEZ closed the Asia leg of their 2026 world tour in the Bangkok area with a large-scale K-pop concert at IMPACT Exhibition Center Hall 5-6.

events.title: GCIRCUIT Songkran 2026
events.summary: GCIRCUIT’s 20th-anniversary Songkran edition returned to EmSphere with four themed night parties and daytime pool parties, reinforcing its role as Asia’s flagship gay circuit festival.

events.title: KYVO // 004 – PHOENIX
events.summary: KYVO returned with a two-day Songkran rooftop chapter on the River City Bangkok Helipad, staging an open-air fire-and-water arena over the Chao Phraya River.

events.title: SPLASH SONGKRAN RCA 2026 – TO SPACE
events.summary: ONYX’s long-running RCA Songkran night festival ran six nights with water-party production and headline nights featuring NERVO, 4B, Bonka, Sally, Amber Na, and TPA & Friends.

events.title: Singha Life presents S2O Songkran Music Festival 2026
events.summary: S2O returned as Bangkok’s global Songkran EDM flagship, confirming April 11–13 at S2O LAND with large-scale water effects and international DJ programming.

events.title: SIAM Songkran Music Festival 2026: The Melora
events.summary: SIAM Songkran’s four-day 2026 edition at Bravo BKK Arena Area featured international EDM headliners across Songkran, including Martin Garrix, Marshmello, John Summit, and Afrojack B2B R3HAB.

events.title: SUPERFLUID 2026 presented by King Power
events.summary: SUPERFLUID staged a free Songkran music-and-water festival at King Power Rangnam with a 20-plus-artist lineup including Jeff Satur, Ink Waruntorn, PiXXie, The Toys, LYKN, PERSES, PROXIE, and more.

events.title: K2O Songkran Music Festival
events.summary: K2O debuted as a one-day K-pop Songkran water festival from the S2O team, combining Korean pop performances with large-scale water, lighting, and stage production.

events.title: FWD Music Live Fest 5
events.summary: FWD Music Live Fest 5 ran for three days at centralwOrld, continuing the post-Songkran live music calendar with a free city-center concert format.

events.title: MUSTACHE x KOLLECTIV — Underground Techno Night
events.summary: Mustache partnered with Bangkok DJ collective Kollectiv for a Thursday underground techno night featuring Martin Sanka, Anchun, Theo DGL, Sadia, and other local selectors.
